Container.Name: Docker-Manager
Container.Overview:
Manage Docker containers remotely with a clean web UI, secure login, and per-user permissions.
Features: - Start, stop, and restart containers from any device - Secure login with admin and user accounts - Per-user container assignments — users only see what you allow - Container groups for quick multi-user assignment - Live container logs viewer - Admin panel for user and group management - Auto-discovers all Docker containers - Mobile-friendly dark UI
Default login: admin / admin (change after first login!)
